Sky++ shader by Andrey Soldatov (Ansol)
Source: https://github.com/AndreySoldatov/Godot-Sky-Plus-Plus
Shader page: https://godotshaders.com/shader/sky-sorta/

The shader code is published under the CC0 1.0 Universal dedication:
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Integrated and performance-tuned for To The Light. The original large HDR
star cubemap and moon texture are intentionally not redistributed; this build
uses procedural cloud textures and keeps the moon/star passes inactive.
